### This data is from "Saudi Audio Dataset for Arabic" It was generated by 
### artificial intelligence, which was trained to recognize speech, the gender 
### of the speaker, and the age group from several Arabic television series. 
### On the basis of this data, it is analyzed by us in order to identify the 
### number of speakers’ gender, age groups, gender, and the percentage of 
### speech processing that is generated from The selected series and several 
### other statistics are then presented in a clear way by representing the 
### data with statistical graphs.
